definitions.gloss: entrance and exit; doorway; way in and out
definitions.explanation: An opening or door that serves as both an entrance and an exit. Common in buildings, rooms, parking lots, and other spaces.

examples.japanese: {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふさがないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{混雑|こんざつ}→混雑：02809_konzatsu⟧しやすい。
examples.english: This building has only one entrance/exit, so it tends to get crowded.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{出入|でい}り→出入り：06609_deiri⟧ (going in and out) + {口|ぐち} (opening, entrance). Refers to a single point that serves as both entrance and exit, or more generally to any doorway or access point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふさぐ: to block the doorway
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: near the entrance/exit
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}: emergency entrance/exit
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the doorway

RELATED WORDS:
- {入口|いりぐち}: entrance (entry only)
- ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧: exit (exit only)
- {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}: serves as both entrance and exit
- ⟦{通用口|つうようぐち}→通用口：20472_tsuuyouguchi⟧: service entrance, staff entrance
